messages:
dana: heads up — deploybot flagged a traffic tilt on the canary for rollout v3.6.1, p95 jumped to ~420ms on the text-gen route

deploybot: auto-safety triggered: throughput throttle applied to canary (50%) at 4130000001. alert_id=DB-SAFETY-413

dana: holding the rollout. do we want the auto-rollback to proceed or perform a manual revert? change window open ~40m

priya: what exact signals tripped? p95 only or errors too?

deploybot: signals: p95 > 350ms for 5m, 5xx delta +0.6% absolute, kv-cache hit ratio down 8%. Auto-rollback is enabled but will not auto-revert pinned dedicated pools without operator confirm.

marco: looks like an EU dedicated pool saw higher error tail; global error volume low so customer impact limited but real

evan: i'd prefer manual rollback. If it's a quantized-kernel interaction in this build, letting it auto-revert loses the live telemetry we need to reproduce root cause.

sasha: agree with evan. manual gives us chance to pin, capture traces, and ship a follow-up patch. we'll also need to update release notes and email affected customers.

dana: ok manual. @marco you take lead on revert. @priya handle comms (status page + account emails).

marco: on it. plan: 1) pin eu-dedicated traffic back to v3.6.0 2) run revert 3) monitor p95/5xx for 10m 4) decide unpin or roll forward

marco: dry-run revert commands:
```
# pin traffic to previous model for pool
redwoodctl rollout pin --pool eu-dedicated --model v3.6.0 --reason "p95 regression v3.6.1"
# then revert canary
redwoodctl rollout revert --canary canary-20241105-eu --confirm
```

priya: drafting release-note entry and account emails. will include ETA and that we're investigating kernel/quantize interactions. also adding console note.

dana: oncall ack needed. @evan pls confirm
evan: ack. watch for 10m post-pin then decide.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-20241105-413, severity=low-med, owner=marco, estimated_start=4130000015

marco: pinning now

marco: pin complete at 4130000020. initiating revert 4130000026

deploybot: revert in progress. progress: 40% traffic shifted back to v3.6.0

sasha: release notes updated: "Rolled back v3.6.1 due to p95 regression on text-gen route; investigating kernel-quantize interaction. RCA to follow."

priya: status page updated and affected accounts emailed (template: cust-rollback-2024-1).

deploybot: revert complete at 4130000050. canary stable on v3.6.0. summary: p95 ~180ms, 5xx back to baseline, kv-cache hit restored

dana: good work. next actions: create postmortem ticket, add an eval prompt set to catch this regression, and consider temporary stricter auto-rollback thresholds for KV-sensitive models

priya: postmortem PM-20241105-413 created and assigned to runtime & s-research. release notes page includes rollback entry and placeholder for fix ETA.

evan: recommend we short-term tighten auto-rollback to p95>300ms for canaries with kv-cache-sensitive flags while we investigate

marco: adding revert steps and command snippets to the runbook. will attach telemetry capture notes. closing thread once RCA draft posted.

sasha: :thumbsup:

dana: thanks team — closing this thread at 4130000065
